# Doodle Codex

> Animated pencil-doodle RPG art library for Norfair Chronicles. The page animates sprites with JavaScript; read these instead.

- [Full text catalog](https://ccherosc.github.io/doodle-codex/catalog.md)
- [Summary JSON](https://ccherosc.github.io/doodle-codex/catalog.json)
- [Engine contract](https://ccherosc.github.io/doodle-codex/GAME_INTEGRATION.md)
